text: Exact acquired class/school/repertoire,components,item and source predicates; no new ability from a label.
Closed acceptance scopes remain exact. Alignment Immunity/Mind Blank are applied per live index but their detailed envelopes are not supplied; dependent cases remain held.
Actual alignment axes,mind/cognition,perception,knowledge and authorized presentation are prerequisites; no invented hidden facts or diagnosis.
Actual bodies,cover,paths,equipment,custody and expression capacity; synthetic scene inputs do not certify a campaign or creature roster.
Complete immutable preceding-round histories and original source/lineage records required; missing evidence is a whole-case hold.
Original regular markers,extra slots,Ready,companion phases,real Reaction triggers and current wallets; no general time engine approval.
Current RP,charges,uses,concentration,materials,death/Null and shared capacities remain binding; no rewind/refund.
Unbound Mirrorsage/feat/granted action/compound-event adapters stay wholly held; no copy/proc/action/resource loop.
Real suppressor and exact target/source scope required; no assumed acquired Greater Dispel,ward or universal antimagic.
No compelled belief,reply,confession,real consent,identity authentication or silent PC retirement.
No game or supplied/historical program execution; no runtime or human-play approval.
All numerical windows and source-specific action-budget exceptions remain balance-qualified.
No invented alignment ontology,mind,plane,afterlife or causal cosmology.
No release,production readiness,domain closure or canonical mutation/application.

Require exact current and historical nested bindings. Conference03 resolves the five02 sidecar-reference defects; preserve correction evidence and original drafts without retaining withdrawn references as current authority.
Every original source question,comparison,proposed Ready correction and future obligation is preserved with its original qualifications.
